findings.source_en: And I will kill the Hexapod.
findings.issue: Glossary freezes Hexapod as transliterated الهكسابود specifically NOT السداسيّ الأرجل (that descriptive phrase is banned because it breaks Merrick's recurring mishearing-gag stem "الهكسا"). This is plain narration (Proxima), not the gag, so it should use the frozen term.
